Crystal Events._comment: Groups together Crystal checks for logic rules (bosses + warp room access).

Clear Gems._comment: Location group which also controls whether Clear Gem checks are made.

Colored Gems._comment: Location group which also controls whether Colored Gem checks are made.

Colored Gem Events._comment: Groups together colored gem checks for the Bug Lite gem path rule.

Platinum Relics._comment: Location group which also controls whether Platinum Relic locations are made (via overridden before_is_category_enabled in hooks/Helpers.py).

Warp Unlocks._comment: Item group which also controls whether warp unlocks are made.
